title: inbound Note without 'published' stores article with no Date: header
description: Trigger: POST /ap/groups/{g}/inbox with Create{Note} where Note has no 'published' field. note_to_article only appends Date header if published is non-empty. The generated article has no Date: header. write_ipld_article_to_ipfs does not validate headers, so the article is stored. NNTP clients then fetch an article that violates RFC 5536 mandatory Date field. The NNTP POST path rejects this, but ActivityPub injection path silently accepts it — corrupts the group. Fix: generate Date from SystemTime::now() when published is absent.
